pr_title: stm32: dma: enable dma with peripheral
pr_body:
Test application and example configuring the spi  peripheral as a client of the dma.
The peripheral request is defined by the client including the channels are fixed for transfer. 

The DT is filled with parameters to set the peripheral request on dma
The dma  channels used for the client transfer (rx, tx) are assigned by the DT among the total nb of channels.
Also tested on nucleo_l476rg board, where the dma requests are fixed (no multiplexer)
Also tested on nucleo_f411re board, where the dma V1 requests are fixed (no multiplexer)

Requires https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/23157

Fix https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/20825

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu francois.ramu@st.com

issue_context.title: stm32: dma: enable dma with peripheral using DMAMUX
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
On some STM32 series, a DMAMUX IP is present to handle the peripheral DMA channels multiplexing. This new IP is not supported yet on STM32 DMA driver

**Describe the solution you'd like**
So to support use of DMA by peripherals on these series, stm32 dma driver should be updated 
to support channel configuration using DMAMUX
comments:
In case the soc supports dmamux feature, for dma periph->mem or mem->periph, the dma drivers is augmented.
A new device dmamux is added and initialized
The dma configuration now includes defines the request line ID and a limited nb of parameters coming from the dma client. The dmamux channel is chosen in the list of free dmamux channels. The DMA instance and stream is connected to this dmamux channel.
The dma start and stop are always transferred through the dmamux.
The dma irq transfer complete and error are handled.
There is no callback for function in case of dmamux overrun error interrupt.
see the [spi: stm32: Enable DMA client
](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/22934)  for using the dma and mux for a client transfer
Requires change in the stm32 dma driver: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/22100

 For stm32 with **DMA** (and no dmamux IP) (like stm32l476 series), the issue requires: 

- enabling the spi dma client https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/23157
- test application with spi client configuration on various stm32 soc: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/23396


For stm32 with **DMA MUX** IP  (like stm32wb55, stm32l4r5 series ), the issue requires: 

- enabling the spi dma client https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/23157
- the stm32 dmamux driver: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/22021
- adaptation of the client like SPI with dmamux on **nucleo_wb55rg** with Device Tree configuration and application: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/23155
